LESSON: ACTIVE LISTENING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.2: Active Listening
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Active Listening, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 8 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can we enhance our pronunciation skills? 4 in turns (e.g. A: 你有叔叔吗?B:是 的,我有一个叔叔, 他叫大卫,你 呢?A:我没有叔叔,我有两个姑 姑。你的叔叔做什么工作?B:我的 叔叔是汉语老师。你的姑姑们呢?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen and repeat vocabulary about extended family members after an audio text (e.g. 叔叔 Shūshu , 姑姑 Gūgu, 舅 舅 Jiùjiu, 阿姨 Āyí, 堂弟 Tángdì, 表妹 Biǎomèi , 姐夫 Jiěfū, 嫂子 Sǎozǐ etc.),

2. say the English equivalents of different professions in turns (e.g. 厨师 Chúshī Cook, 护士 Hùshì- Nurse, 记者 Jìzhě- Reporter, 会计师 Kuàijìshī-Accountant, 律师 Lǜshī- Lawyer, 老师Lǎoshī- Teacher , 医生 Yīshēng-Doctor) ,

3. talk about members of their extended family (name, age, profession and occupation e.g. 我表妹叫安娜。她今年 25 岁。她是护士。),

4. role-play asking peers specific details about members of their extended family

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen and repeat vocabulary about extended family members after an audio text (e.g. 叔叔 Shūshu , 姑姑 Gūgu, 舅 舅 Jiùjiu, 阿姨 Āyí, 堂弟 Tángdì, 表妹 Biǎomèi , 姐夫 Jiěfū, 嫂子 Sǎozǐ etc.),
2. say the English equivalents of different professions in turns (e.g. 厨师 Chúshī Cook, 护士 Hùshì- Nurse, 记者 Jìzhě- Reporter, 会计师 Kuàijìshī-Accountant, 律师 Lǜshī- Lawyer, 老师Lǎoshī- Teacher , 医生 Yīshēng-Doctor) ,
3. talk about members of their extended family (name, age, profession and occupation e.g. 我表妹叫安娜。她今年 25 岁。她是护士。),
4. role-play asking peers specific details about members of their extended family

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Active Listening together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy: This is developed as the learner identifies and introduces members of their extended family with their roles

during the role-play.

Values:
Unity is developed as the learner collaboratively introduces members of their extended family in class.
